All operations are confined to expected service management and do not involve downloading, executing external code, or exfiltrating data.

There is no obfuscated code, suspicious network activity, or unauthorized system modifications. The actions taken are consistent with typical AUR package behavior for a system monitoring tool that uses systemd services.
